text:
maya: Quick a11y pass on the Model panel — VoiceOver + keyboard. Found: title not in rotor, example cards read as static text, version selector announced as button only.

sam: Which OS/browser? small repro?

maya: macOS Ventura, Safari, VoiceOver. Tab into panel, rotor doesn't show heading; example text contrast ~3.8:1; version combobox says 'button' no value.

alex: Fixes: use semantic <h2>, make example cards buttons (they copy/expand), bump example text to #626262, stronger focus (outline 2px solid #2d8cff).

sam: I'll open a tiny PR for markup + color token + focus style.

tina: a11y-bot scan: contrast failures on example-text; missing aria-expanded/aria-haspopup on version selector; region missing accessible name.

jeff: Prioritize semantic controls, selector announcements, and color tokens. Plan + QA checklist please.

alex: Plan posted in PR: div->button, aria-expanded + aria-controls, aria-labels for icon-only buttons, aria-live polite on expanded content.

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1428 deploying to staging, tagging @maya for verification.

a11y-bot: Staging scan after PR: contrast warnings resolved; remaining: expanded region lacks accessible name.

maya: On staging I can now see heading in rotor, examples announced as buttons, selector reads value. One remaining nit: add aria-label/aria-labelledby to expanded region and ensure it's announced (aria-live polite helps).

jeff: Great catch. Schedule 15m voiceover check after merge.
